headline: Yellen Announces World Bank Overhaul to Begin by April
summary: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen stated that initial phases of a World Bank overhaul will begin by April, focusing on expanding the multilateral lender's remit to address climate change and global economic shocks.
why: The World Bank is the primary multilateral lender for emerging markets. Reforms adjust balance-sheet leverage rules and alter concessionary climate financing flows worldwide.
